difficulty_reason: Prove the functor G-Torsors -> G/B-Torsors sending (U, b, X) to (U, b, X seen as a sheaf) is an equivalence of stacks in groupoids over (Sch/S)_fppf: invoke stacks-lemma-characterize-essentially-surjective-when-ff; the functor is fully faithful because the category of algebraic spaces over S is a full subcategory of the category of sheaves on (Sch/S)_fppf; condition (2) of that lemma holds because all objects on both sides are locally trivial torsors; hence an equivalence.
